findings.desc: pinn_report_render trusts caller-supplied benchmarkJson/benchmarkPath and returns or renders report claims unchanged. handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:92-95 casts parsed JSON as PinnBenchmarkReport, and :110-113 returns it directly for JSON or passes it to renderPinnReportText. core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:580-591 then prints report.claims.productionDone/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/pdeCorrectnessClaim and report.boundary as supplied. Verified by direct handler invocation: a supplied report with those flags true renders productionDone: true, authorityDone: true, fullAuthorityDone: true, pdeCorrectnessClaim: true, and a caller-controlled external Authority completion boundary. This violates the pack boundary that local reporting must not claim PDE correctness, production readiness, or external Authority completion; supplied reports need validation/normalization or rejection before rendering.

M4 test/evidence coverage claims the deterministic B1-B15 benchmark, but the implemented/tested injection corpus does not match the governing plan. The plan requires B1-B15 cases such as spec changed while residual reused, BC changed while BC report reused, checkpoint mismatch, collocation changes, narrowed grid, baseline benchmark mismatch, stale figure provenance, missing seed/config, low-loss/high-OOS residual, threshold changed, code changed after checkpoint, metric changed, and manually edited figures/tables (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-pinn-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md:171-187). The runtime corpus instead defines B1-B15 as missing identity, missing/failing receipts, verifier hash mismatch, generic stale receipt, production/PDE overclaims, and missing adapters (packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:151-166), and the smoke only asserts those substituted reason codes (packages/main/src/tasks/pinn-claim-admissibility-smoke.ts:32-46). As a result, npm run test:pinn-claim-admissibility and pinn_benchmark_run can pass without exercising several required B1-B15 failure modes, so TEST would overclaim M4 coverage.

Duplicate verifier receipts for the same adapter are silently collapsed by Map construction in packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:385, so an evidence payload containing a stale/failing residual receipt followed by a clean residual receipt advances with allowed=true and no reasons. This violates the fail-closed/ambiguous-evidence boundary for the PINN claim-admissibility pack; duplicate adapter receipts should be rejected before selecting a receipt.
